script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LIVING ROOM – DAY

The room is filled with natural light. A family of five sits on the cozy, worn-out sofa, their eyes locked on a large flat-screen television.

JESSICA (45, ambitious mother) sits at the end, with one arm around her husband MIKE (50, supportive father), their three children – NICO (12, curious boy), OLIVIA (10, artistic girl), and MAX (8, energetic boy) – nestled between them.

TV: (broadcasting)
And the winner of the national science fair is... John Doe from Chicago!

NICO's eyes widen, and he jumps up from the couch, excitement etched on his face. The family erupts in applause.

NICO: (excitedly) I can do that, Mom! I can build something amazing!

JESSICA: (smiling) I've always believed in you, Nic. You have what it takes.

CUT TO:

INT. KITCHEN – NIGHT

Jessica, deep in thought, stirs a pot of spaghetti while Mike sets the table.

MIKE: (casually) You've been so focused on the kids lately. Are you sure you don't have an idea brewing for yourself?

Jessica hesitates, then looks at Mike with determination.

JESSICA: I have been, actually. I want to start my own business – a place where kids can learn and explore their passions. I think I can make a real difference.

MIKE: (impressed) That's fantastic, Jess! I'll support you in any way I can.

INT. CLASSROOM – DAY

Jessica stands at the front of a large classroom filled with eager children, holding a microphone.

JESSICA: (enthusiastically) Welcome to Passion Plays, where we explore, create, and learn! Today, we're going to start our very first project. I want each of you to tell me what you love most in the world, and we'll build a project around it!

INT. WAREHOUSE – NIGHT

Jessica, Mike, and the children work tirelessly, transforming an old warehouse into their dream learning space.

MAX: (excitedly) Can I help paint the walls, Mom?

JESSICA: (smiling) Of course, Max. We're a team.

INT. PASSION PLAYS – DAY

Passion Plays is now open, and the children are in awe of their new learning environment. They explore, create, and collaborate on projects that reflect their unique interests.

INT. PASSION PLAYS – EVENING

Jessica looks around the bustling room, her heart swelling with pride. She turns to Mike, who takes her hand and gives it a squeeze.

MIKE: (whispering) You did it, Jess.

JESSICA: (tearfully) We did it together.

INT. LIVING ROOM – NIGHT

The family sits on the couch, watching the nightly news.

TV: And in local news, Passion Plays has become a wild success. Children are thriving in this unique learning environment.

NICO, OLIVIA, and MAX share a proud look. Jessica and Mike exchange a satisfied glance.

JESSICA: (smiling) We're making a difference, one passion at a time.

FADE OUT.

THE END
